sources.name: atlas
sources.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production sprite atlas for a softly hand-painted travel jigsaw. Five independently painted watercolor/gouache cutouts, TRUE transparent RGBA with empty alpha between subjects. Landscape1536x1024, three columns/two rows, bottom-right cell completely empty. Very wide transparent gutters, each COMPLETE subject centered inside own cell, maxheight400, no touching borders or crossing cells. Do not paint background/halo/grid/checkerboard/stickers/text. Natural subtly textured paint, gentle upper-left daylight, no hard outlines. Subjects in cell order: A cocoa-brown potting room: TOP LEFT soft cream narrow curtain panel with top loops; TOP MIDDLE small fern frond with thin bottom stem; TOP RIGHT small white flower on thin long stem; BOTTOM LEFT small cream cotton cord bow resting flat on a rolled cloth seen from above45degrees, subtle contact shadow directly under cord; BOTTOM MIDDLE thin sage cloth tie hanging from a tiny top loop. No window/cloth-roll/peg/pot.
